identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase Ib/II Study Of JS015 Combination Therapy in Advanced Solid Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase Ib/II Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Preliminary Efficacy of JS015 Combination Therapy in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a phase Ib/II, open-label, multicenter study to evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics (PK), and preliminary efficacy of JS015 combination therapy in patients with advanced solid tumors. The Recommended dose for phase II trial （RP2D） will be determined based on the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and efficacy.

armGroups.label: Cohort 1: esophogeal squamous carcinoma
armGroups.description: In Cohort 1, patients will be treated with JS015 in combination with paclitaxel or irinotecan

armGroups.label: Cohort 2: gastric cancer
armGroups.description: In Cohort 2, patients will be treated with JS015 in combination with paclitaxel

armGroups.label: Cohort 3: gastric cancer
armGroups.description: In Cohort 3, patients will be treated with JS015 in combination with toripalimab and XELOX

armGroups.label: Cohort 4: colorectal cancer
armGroups.description: In Cohort 4, patients will be treated with JS015 plus bevacizumab in combination with XELOX or FOLFIRI

armGroups.label: Cohort 5: pancreatic cancer
armGroups.description: In Cohort 5, patients will be treated with JS015 in combination with toripalimab, albumin-bound paclitaxel and gemcitabine

interventions.name: JS015
interventions.description: JS015 will be administered intravenously (IV) on days 1 and 15 every 28 day cycle, or day 1 every 21 day cycle, based on different combined chemotherapy.

interventions.name: Toripalimab
interventions.description: Toripalimab will be administered intravenously (IV) on day 1 every 21 day cycle.

interventions.name: Paclitaxel
interventions.description: Paclitaxel will be administered intravenously (IV) on day 1 every 21 day cycle.

interventions.name: Irinotecan
interventions.description: Irinotecan will be administered intravenously (IV) on days 1 and 15 every 28 day cycle.

interventions.name: Capecitabine
interventions.description: Capecitabin will be administered orally twice daily from day 1 to 14 every 21 day cycle.

interventions.name: Oxaliplatin
interventions.description: Oxaliplatin will be administered intravenously (IV) on day 1 every 21 day cycle.

interventions.name: Bevacizumab
interventions.description: Bevacizumab of 5mg/kg will be administered intravenously (IV) on days 1 and 15 every 28 day cycle, or7.5mg/kg on day 1 every 21 day cycle, based on different combined chemotherapy.

interventions.name: Fluorouracil
interventions.description: Fluorouracil will be administered intravenously (IV) on days 1 and 15 every 28 day cycle.

interventions.name: Leucovorin
interventions.description: Leucovorin will be administered intravenously (IV) on days 1 and 15 every 28 day cycle.

interventions.name: Gemcitabine
interventions.description: Gemcitabine will be administered intravenously (IV) on days 1 and 8 every 21 day cycle.

interventions.name: Albumin-Bound Paclitaxel
interventions.description: Albumin-bound paclitaxel will be administered intravenously (IV) on days 1 and 8 every 21 day cycle.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Recommended dose for phase II trial RP2D
primaryOutcomes.description: Recommended dose for phase II trial

secondaryOutcomes.description: The highest plasma drug concentration that can be achieved after medication
The time it takes for the drug to reach its maximum concentration (Cmax) in the plasma after administration
The time it takes for the concentration of the drug in the plasma to be reduced by 50%

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Objective response rate (ORR) based on Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors 1.1 (RECIST1.1)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the proportion of subjects who achieved partial response (PR) or complete response (CR)
The time from first dose to Disease progression or death
The time from first dose to death from any cause
